subject: Quick automation idea for test-client.com
body:
Hi,

I came across test-client.com and noticed you might be dealing with manual data entry.

I build custom automation bots (web scraping, data pipelines, workflow orchestration) that typically cut manual work by 60-80%.

Here's what I can do for you:
- One-time automation build
- Delivery in 2-3 days
- Price: $500-$1,000

No long-term contracts. If it saves you time, we continue. If not, you walk away.

Want me to send over a 2-minute Loom demo of a similar bot I built?

Best,
MECOS Automation
